_comment: Advisories accepted on the patched core, checked by .github/workflows/audit.yml.
The audit FAILS on any advisory not listed here, so one published against a version we
already ship is surfaced instead of going unnoticed (COMCL-1549). It WARNS about ids
listed here that no longer appear, so this file gets pruned as libraries are bumped.
Reachability assessments are recorded on COMCL-1549.
This file lives under .github/ deliberately: the Packaging action builds its patch with
'git diff .. :!.github', so anything outside .github would be shipped inside the tarball.

accepted.CVE-2026-46643: knplabs/knp-snappy v1.4.4, High. Unescaped binary path. Not reachable: wkhtmltopdfPath is an administer-CiviCRM domain setting. The fix (v1.7.1) declares php >= 8.1, above both lines' config.platform.php (7.4.0 / 8.0.0), and additionally requires psr/log ^2.0||^3.0 while both lines sit on 1.1.4. See GHSA-87qc-37cw-84h4 below.
accepted.CVE-2026-46683: knplabs/knp-snappy v1.4.4, Medium. Same package, same blockers as CVE-2026-46643.
accepted.CVE-2025-45769: firebase/php-jwt, Low. Deliberately not taken. Upstream widened the constraint in b64a71eec3 and the pick applies on 6.4.1, but v7.0.0 adds HMAC key-length validation throwing DomainException for keys shorter than the digest; CryptoRegistry::addSymmetricKey() enforces no minimum and its b64 KDF is a passthrough, and DomainException extends LogicException, which neither branch's CryptoJwt::decode() catches. Master is protected only by ca3423463e, from a refactor chain we do not carry.

accepted_repo_level.GHSA-87qc-37cw-84h4: knplabs/knp-snappy, Low. Repository-level advisory, invisible to composer audit. Affects <= 1.7.1, i.e. the fixed release too, so bumping would not clear it even if the platform allowed.

accepted_unpollable.marcj/topsort: HTTP 404 - the GitHub repository for topsort/topsort has been removed or renamed. Packagist still covers the package via composer audit, so it is checked by one source rather than two. Re-check if the package is ever bumped.
